answer.answer: Based on date_first–date_last ranges overlapping each window, 42 studies contributed NCEI ocean-water samples during 2015–2019, versus 3 during 2000–2004 (Goldstein 2013, Law 2010, Law 2014). Because only start/end dates are given rather than per-sample dates, studies with long date spans are counted wherever their range overlaps a window, so exact within-window sample counts are uncertain.
